# Uploading the name tag to MakerWorld

1. Go to [makerworld.com](https://makerworld.com), sign in, and click **Upload**.
2. Choose **Parametric Model Maker** (OpenSCAD) and upload `name_tag.scad`, plus `default.png` and `default.svg` as its default files. These are the sample logos buyers see before they upload their own; MakerWorld's upload button replaces them, so keep these exact names.
3. Click **Generate** with the default settings, then try a few others (SVG logo, no logo, 1 and 3 logo colors, each style) to check they all build.
4. Fill in the form from `makerworld-listing.txt`: model name, summary, category, tags, license and description.
5. Add pictures: at least one photo of a real print (MakerWorld requires one), plus the `preview-*.png` renders.
6. Create the print profile as described under "PRINT PROFILE NOTES" in the listing.
7. Publish.
